properties.name: Three of flo2's entries were already answered by v0.65.0, cut the same day the report was written
properties.statement: Checked entry by entry against the v0.65.0 surface on 2026-09-19. ① F13 ('add_epoch lands at arrived, so creating a FUTURE release cut asserts it already shipped') — ANSWERED: add_epoch now takes `status`, its description names what omitting it lands, and `planned` is sayable on the same call. ② The F8/F9/F14 correction's real ask ('list_skills DROPS them — the data exists one layer down and never reaches a consumer') — ANSWERED: list_skills and get_skill now serve `summary` and `audience`, and `find_skills` finds a skill from a sentence in a person's words. flo2's palette can show real human copy without a hand-maintained allowlist. ③ F4's original ask, an append or section-replace on a long prose field — ANSWERED by `replace_text`, which moves one sentence or appends a dated note without re-sending the field. WHAT IS NOT ANSWERED and stands as its own finding: F4 SHARPENED's measurement that a full-field rewrite SILENTLY DROPS content, and its cheapest remedy, a length delta in the reply. replace_text removes the pressure to rewrite; it does not guard a rewrite somebody performs anyway.
